I build open-source quantum computing tools, mostly for the Qiskit ecosystem. My background is in mathematics — number theory, graph theory, and formal proof in Lean 4 — which tends to show up in how I approach circuit construction and error mitigation: as things to prove correct, not just get working.

Three projects are live so far: 
**Qiberis**, a backend-agnostic circuit API spanning Qiskit, Cirq, and PennyLane.
**Qiskit SQD Dashboard**, a live convergence widget for sample-based quantum diagonalization. Both are verified Qiskit Ecosystem members.
**Qiskit StateViz**, Interactive, Plotly-based statevector visualizations for Qiskit — a drop-in, rotate/zoom/hover companion to the static matplotlib views in qiskit.visualization.
